issues.evidence: Tibetan སྤྲིན་རུམ་ན (Skt meghaghanāndhakāre) means 'in the thick mass of clouds'; bo-kunpal 1-5 glosses it as སྤྲིན་རུམ་ 'cloud-bank'. Nothing in the Tibetan or commentaries supports 'womb'.
issues.fix: within a dense mass of clouds

issues.span: occasionally / Intelligence for merit arises for a moment in the world
issues.evidence: བརྒྱ་ལམ་ན 'once in a hundred (instances/paths)' and ཐང་འགའ་འབྱུང 'only rarely arises'; bo-shenga 1-5 ཐང་འགའ་ཙམ་འབྱུང་ངོ and bo-kunpal 1-5 (བརྒྱ་ལན་རེ་སྟོང་ལན་གཉིས་ཙམ་འབྱུང 'occurs about once in a hundred or thousand times'). 'For a moment' belongs to the lightning simile (སྐད་ཅིག), not to the arising of the thought (Skt kṣaṇaṃ is not in the Tibetan line); rarity is lost.
issues.fix: once in a hundred times, the thought toward merit rarely arises in the world

issues.evidence: འགྲོ་བའི་གནས་ (Skt gati-pattana) refers to the realms/destinies of rebirth: bo-shenga 1-11 འགྲོ་བ་ལྔའི་གནས་ 'the abodes of the five migrations'; bo-gyaltsab 1-11 gives འཁོར་བའི་རྒུད་པ་ 'the miseries of saṃsāra'. Here འགྲོ་བ is 'migration/destiny', not 'beings', so the locked 'wandering being' misleads.
issues.fix: the realms of migration (the destinies of saṃsāra)
